data.title: Light-powered 250-nm nanobots boost brain drug delivery fivefold
data.description: Caltech's 250-nm biodegradable nanorobots use near-infrared light to improve drug delivery across the blood–brain barrier in mice.
data.author: Neetika Walter
data.keywords: blood–brain barrier, BrainBots, Caltech, drug delivery, glioblastoma, Nanorobots, near-infrared light, neurological disorders.
